scenarios.title: A spell with bargain can be cast bargained only if an artifact, enchantment or token can be sacrificed

setup.notes: B has cast Grizzly Bears and A has priority with it on the stack. Ice Out costs {1} less to cast if it is bargained. All of A's permanents are untapped.

decisions: A considers casting Ice Out targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Islands and, as the additional bargain cost, sacrificing Short Sword.

variants.label: sword_to_sacrifice
variants.expected: Casting Ice Out bargained is legal: it costs {U}{U} after the reduction, Short Sword (an artifact) is a legal sacrifice, and Grizzly Bears on the stack is a legal target.

variants.label: no_permanent_to_sacrifice
variants.delta: A controls no Short Sword; its battlefield is two Islands only.
variants.expected: Casting Ice Out is not legal: no artifact, enchantment or token can be sacrificed, so it cannot be bargained and costs {1}{U}{U}, which two Islands cannot pay.

operation.unclassifiable: Removes a permanent from the base battlefield; no fork operation removes a permanent.

variants.label: only_a_creature
variants.delta: Short Sword is replaced on A's battlefield by Grizzly Bears (a nonartifact, nontoken creature).
variants.expected: Casting Ice Out is not legal: Grizzly Bears is not an artifact, enchantment or token, so the spell cannot be bargained and costs {1}{U}{U}, which two Islands cannot pay.

detector.none: Whether an artifact, enchantment or token could be sacrificed as an optional additional cost is not recorded on a playability decision candidate (only can_play, affordable, has_legal_target, legal_targets, cost_after_adjustment, failed_checks); the optional sacrifice choice appears in no record field or event.

scenarios.title: A spell cast with its bargain cost paid is bargained and uses its bargained effect

setup.notes: A's library is listed top card first.

decisions: A casts Torch the Tower targeting Hill Giant, tapping Mountain and, as the additional bargain cost, sacrificing Short Sword.
Both players pass; Torch the Tower resolves. For scry 1, A looks at the top card of the library and keeps it on top.

variants.label: bargained
variants.expected: Short Sword goes to A's graveyard as a cost. Torch the Tower deals 3 damage to Hill Giant (3/3) and A scries 1. Hill Giant would die this turn, so it is exiled instead of going to B's graveyard.

variants.label: not_bargained
variants.delta: A casts Torch the Tower without sacrificing Short Sword.
variants.expected: Short Sword stays on the battlefield. Torch the Tower deals 2 damage to Hill Giant, which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked. A does not scry.

operation.unclassifiable: A different casting choice: the caster does not sacrifice a permanent for bargain; no fork operation changes a player's choice.

scenarios.title: A bargain-conditional part with a target has that target only if the spell was bargained

setup.notes: A's library is listed top card first. The only target Brave the Wilds can have is the land of its bargained part.

decisions: A casts Brave the Wilds, tapping one Forest and, as the additional bargain cost, sacrificing Short Sword. A chooses the other Forest as the target land.
Both players pass; Brave the Wilds resolves and A searches the library for a basic land card, taking the Forest.

variants.label: bargained
variants.expected: Short Sword goes to A's graveyard as a cost. The untapped Forest becomes a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste that is still a land. A's library Forest moves to A's hand.

variants.label: not_bargained
variants.delta: A casts Brave the Wilds without sacrificing Short Sword; no target is chosen.
variants.expected: Brave the Wilds is cast with no target and resolves rather than fizzling. No land becomes a creature. A's library Forest moves to A's hand and Short Sword stays on the battlefield.

operation.unclassifiable: A different casting choice: the caster does not bargain and so chooses no target; no fork operation changes a player's choice.
